name: Computer Use
tagline: Browser, desktop and Chrome control in one install
description: Computer Use gathers the three ways Whilo drives a computer. Browser automation runs the tabs Whilo manages: open and close tabs, read a page snapshot, click, type, press keys, fill 1 to 16 ordinary main-frame fields from one fresh snapshot, and run many steps in a single scripted call. Each action passes the tab queue, so a person who takes a tab stops the agent until it is released, and a password, one-time code, CAPTCHA or payment goes through secure input or a takeover. Computer use reaches the rest of the desktop through cua-driver, the MIT driver Whilo packages and pins: it reads the screen and the accessibility tree and posts input, and because Whilo spawns it directly, macOS grants Screen Recording and Accessibility to Whilo rather than to a helper. Both of those run inside Whilo already. This listing adds the third: Chrome over the DevTools Protocol, through the ChromeDevTools server, which drives a Chrome window of its own with navigate, snapshot, click, type, network and performance reads, and screenshots.

prompts.text: Open the pricing page, read what each plan includes, and tell me which one fits a team of two.
Run one script that searches the docs site for rate limits and returns the table it finds.
Look at my screen, find the invoice window, and read the total that is due.
